EXERCISE — FICTIONAL

1. Commercial and press reporting states that commercial bulk carrier Mirenda loads aggregate at quay 1.

2. Entities identified in this reporting: Mirenda, Torvik Harbour Authority.

3. Schedule data show 3 affected sailings, all within the period 2220Z to 0500Z.

4. The same account appears in 20 outlets within 20 hours, with wording sufficiently similar to suggest a single origin.

5. Open reporting establishes that the event was publicly visible. It establishes nothing about military significance.
